today.label: Tuesday, September 29

items.title: Diocesan Blue Mass
items.description: On the Feast of St. Michael, the Diocese holds a special 'Blue Mass' honoring the first responders who protect us. Join us at 10:30am at St. Agnes in Blackwood for this wonderful celebration. Bishop Williams will celebrate the Mass.

upcoming.label: Wednesday, September 30
upcoming.title: 40 Hours Devotion Opening Mass
upcoming.description: This 9am Mass will open our 40 Hours Devotion with a special Healing Mass for anyone in need of mental, physical, or spiritual healing. The Sacrament of Anointing of the Sick will be provided.

upcoming.label: Wednesday, September 30
upcoming.title: Weekly Newman Night Dinner
upcoming.description: Join us for a Newman favorite meal: Chick-fil-a! Following dinner, we'll head to St. Bridget for our 40 Hours Devotion.

upcoming.label: Wednesday, September 30
upcoming.title: 40 Hours Devotion Praise and Worship Vespers
upcoming.description: Join at St. Bridget for Vespers (Evening Prayer) as part of our 40 Hours Devotion. This Vespers will feature praise and worship songs during adoration.

upcoming.label: Thursday, October 1
upcoming.title: 40 Hours Devotion Vocations Mass
upcoming.description: Join us for a Mass for Vocations at St. Bridget. Guest preacher Fr. Stephen Robbins will be preaching and we will install our new altar servers as this Mass.

upcoming.label: Friday, October 2
upcoming.title: 40 Hours Devotions Solemn Closing Mass
upcoming.description: Join us for the final Mass that closes our 40 Hours Devotion. Fr. Stephen Robbins will again preach this Mass and we'll have many special musical selections, including Mozart's Ave Verum Corpus and Misa de Angelis.

upcoming.label: Sunday, October 4
upcoming.title: Life Chain
upcoming.description: Join us for our annual life chain where we peacefully witness the sanctity and dignity of human life.

upcoming.label: Wednesday, October 14
upcoming.title: Weekly Newman Night Dinner and Talk
upcoming.description: Join us for a free meal at 6pm followed by the 2nd part of a series by Fr. Piro, 'Back to the Basics of the Catholic Faith.' This part is titled 'How Can We Experience Christ?'
